game_title: Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition

author: DarkPixel
quote: The first location and the graphics were awesome. But that's all. Next locations are boring, the fights are boring, exploration is too easy, because every mistake with falling down is forgiven by many platforms and places, where I can go back without any complications. System od meditation is so stupid, the enemies are respawning, really? Like Far Cry 2. The upgrades are boring, nothing new or special, like in milions of other games. But first of all, is that a Star Wars? The universum with the force and lightsabers? I can't even throw my saber into enemies. I can't pick up the stormtroopers by my force and throw them out. I can't do anything I want to do in Star Wars game. Instead of that, I can... slow down a propeller or some strange machines just to go through them? I'm so disappointed with this game. I won't waste anymore minute for this, The old grandpa, Star Wars The Force Unleashed is much much better.

author: DarkPixel
quote: This is one of the best games I ever played. Good campaign and awesome multiplayer. The maps are great, the pilot skills are great, and the titans are great. I love this game so much.
